paragraphs: MindMixer sells one platform that combines social media management, community engagement surveys, and archiving for government communications teams. Content and workflow features cover campaign planning, collaboration on content, approval tracking, and automatic archiving, so teams manage messages in one place. The social media tools schedule and publish across accounts, monitor and moderate comments, and capture every interaction for compliance.

Surveying and engagement tools gather community feedback and measure sentiment, with AI-powered survey creation and response analysis. Archiving runs automatically for public records requests and FOIA standards, with policy-based archiving, search and export options, and configurable retention schedules. The site states that Social Assurance for Government is now MindMixer by Social Assurance.

Buyers named on these pages are government offices and agencies, and the platform is described as built for the public sector. The site also names banking, financial services, and education among the markets served.

quote.text: Built for the public sector, MindMixer simplifies every part of your communication workflow so your team can focus on what matters most: informing, engaging, and earning public trust.
